name: Dr. Ralph Seemann
headline: Deloitte | M&A Transaction Services | Commercial Due Diligence | Strategy
summary: Experienced Director with a demonstrated history of working in Commercial Due Diligences on the Buy- and Sell-Side, Strategy Projects and Business Reviews in restructuring projects (e.g. IDW S6) for private equity and corporate clients. Skilled in Growth Strategies, Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) with focus on Buy-/Sell-side Commercial Due Diligence, Corporate Development, Crisis Communications, Reputation Management and Corporate Communications. Strong professional graduated from HSG St. Gallen, University Munich (LMU), Erasmus University of Rotterdam, and CDTM - Center for Digital Technology and Management (Elite Network of Bavaria).
